mapper.select: SELECT p.policy_id, p.policy_name AS name, p.begin_date, p.end_date, p.application_period, upb.created_at FROM user_policy_bookmarks upb JOIN policies p ON upb.policy_id = p.policy_id WHERE upb.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.policy_id, p.policy_name AS name, p.begin_date, p.end_date, p.application_period, upb.created_at FROM user_policy_bookmarks upb JOIN policies p ON upb.policy_id = p.policy_id WHERE upb.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY upb.created_at DESC LIMIT #{requestDto.size} OFFSET #{requestDto.offset}
SELECT l.loan_id, l.product_name AS name, l.begin_date, l.end_date, ulb.created_at FROM user_loan_bookmarks ulb JOIN loans l ON ulb.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE ulb.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT l.loan_id, l.product_name AS name, l.begin_date, l.end_date, ulb.created_at FROM user_loan_bookmarks ulb JOIN loans l ON ulb.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE ulb.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ulb.created_at DESC LIMIT #{requestDto.size} OFFSET #{requestDto.offset}

SELECT d.document_name AS documentName, COUNT(DISTINCT all_required_docs.product_identifier) AS productCount, d.issuing_authority_url AS issuingUrl, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_documents ud WHERE ud.document_id = d.document_id AND ud.user_id = #{userId} ) THEN '보유' ELSE '미보유' END AS possessionStatus FROM documents d JOIN ( SELECT rd.document_id, upb.policy_id AS product_identifier FROM required_documents rd JOIN user_policy_bookmarks upb ON rd.policy_id = upb.policy_id WHERE upb.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT rd.document_id, CONCAT('loan_', ulb.loan_id) AS product_identifier FROM required_documents rd JOIN user_loan_bookmarks ulb ON rd.loan_id = ulb.loan_id WHERE ulb.user_id = #{userId} ) AS all_required_docs ON d.document_id = all_required_docs.document_id GROUP BY d.document_id, d.document_name, d.issuing_authority_url ORDER BY productCount DESC, d.document_name ASC

SELECT name, type, organization, dDay, prepared, required FROM ( -- 정책 즐겨찾기 부분 SELECT p.policy_name AS name, 'POLICY' AS type, p.supervising_organization_name AS organization, DATEDIFF(p.end_date, CURDATE()) AS dDay, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rd.document_id) FROM required_documents rd JOIN user_documents ud ON rd.document_id = ud.document_id AND ud.user_id = upb.user_id WHERE rd.policy_id = upb.policy_id) AS prepared, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM required_documents WHERE policy_id = upb.policy_id) AS required, upb.created_at AS bookmarked_at -- 정렬을 위한 컬럼 FROM user_policy_bookmarks upb JOIN policies p ON upb.policy_id = p.policy_id WHERE upb.user_id = #{userId}
UNION ALL
-- 대출 즐겨찾기 부분 SELECT l.product_name AS name, 'LOAN' AS type, l.company_name AS organization, NULL AS dDay, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rd.document_id) FROM required_documents rd JOIN user_documents ud ON rd.document_id = ud.document_id AND ud.user_id = ulb.user_id WHERE rd.loan_id = ulb.loan_id) AS prepared, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM required_documents WHERE loan_id = ulb.loan_id) AS required, ulb.created_at AS bookmarked_at FROM user_loan_bookmarks ulb JOIN loans l ON ulb.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE ulb.user_id = #{userId} ) AS combined_results
ORDER BY combined_results.bookmarked_at DESC
